name: A2UI Chat
description: Renderiza UI generativa A2UI no chat. Agentes chamam a tool render_ui(surface) para desenhar cards, listas, inputs e botões na resposta.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在对话中渲染 A2UI 生成式界面。智能体调用 render_ui(surface) 工具，在回复气泡中绘制卡片、列表、输入框和按钮。
description_i18n.en-US: Render A2UI generative UI in chat. Agents call the render_ui(surface) tool to draw cards, lists, inputs and buttons in the reply.

author: QwenPaw Team

tools.name: render_ui
tools.description: Renderiza uma surface A2UI no chat

config_fields.name: interactivity
config_fields.label: Interatividade
config_fields.help: read-only renderiza estático; editable habilita edição + envio ao agente.
